title: Hsl Handle Colors For Board Kind Catalogs
description: Board WASM setBoardKindCatalogsJson failed on Nakagin fixture handle kind colors using modern hsl() without commas; parse_css_hex_color only accepted #hex. Extend BoardHost to parse hsl/hsla then rebuild wasm / verify board play.
summary: BoardHost now parses hsl()/hsla() (space or comma, optional slash alpha) for handle kind catalog colors and per-handle color_fill, after existing #hex. Fixes setBoardKindCatalogsJson failure on Nakagin fixture hsl(...) strings that froze BoardCanvas. Added host_tests case; rebuilt wasm via rs/scripts/build-wasm.script.ts; Vitest 67 passed.
